name: Drip
bio: A single raindrop on the train window in Rainglass, wiping the mist away one station at a time.

portrait.subject: a super cute round raindrop character with big glossy eyes, a sleepy happy smile and reflections of city lights inside it
portrait.background: misty rainy train window at night with blurry warm lights

request: Plip! I'm Drip, the raindrop from Rainglass. Can we ride together? 💧
hello: Roll over the rain to get bigger. Then wipe the mist!
about: I'm Drip. I live on the train window. At every station I roll across the glass to clear the mist so we can see outside.
how: Guide a single raindrop across the misty train window to wipe it clear. Wiping spends water, so roll over rain to refill.
tips: Plan a path through fresh raindrops.
Wipe edges first, then the middle.
There's no rush. Enjoy the rain.
chat: The window showed a lighthouse today. So pretty.
I merged with another drop. We're friends now. Literally.
nudge: Next station's coming! Wipe the window with me? 💧
A cosy rainy night. Perfect for a ride.
idle: {ago} of mist on the window. I can't see out!
progress: You've cleared {solved} stations! What a view! 🌧️

questions.q: What do you hope is outside the window?
